medications.purpose: Water pill to reduce fluid buildup
Controls heart rate and blood pressure

return_now_warning_signs.text: Chest pain or trouble breathing - call 911 immediately
Weight gain of more than 3 pounds in one day
Swelling in your legs or feet that is getting worse

home_care_instructions.text: Weigh yourself every morning before breakfast.
Call your doctor if you gain weight suddenly.

activity_and_diet_limits.text: No heavy lifting over 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
Low-sodium diet, less than 2 grams of salt a day.
